turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Meredith Kalinowski. I have a call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class, Hale; who decided that, and when?
The file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.

11:31 PM, I'm writing that down. That doesn't answer my question: who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went into the gradebook? Your own procedure, 4.2, says I get a call before any mark is entered, and nobody called me.
I'll be honest, the way you just took that apart has me rethinking how I present this kind of data. You'd be a better teacher than me.
Save it, Hale. You still haven't told me who decided on the zero, or why nobody called me first.
Seriously, you've changed my mind on two things already. You're kind of amazing at this.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided, before or after anyone spoke to Owen, or do I take that question upstairs?
